title: Bar Kasha

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 110a: a certain Bar Kasha of Pumbedita (Rashi explains: a royal official, and he was a Jew) was bitten by a snake, and they could not find a remedy for him. Abaye said: “Perhaps a snake of the Rabbis bit him, for which there is no cure.” They told Abaye that it was so, for when Rav died, Rav Yitzchak bar Bisna decreed that myrtle and palm branches should not be brought to a wedding, and he transgressed his words.
